hypothesis: For the same third-contact entry, closing at the opposite support/resistance or on a fixed 3/5/8% price target may improve monthly net outcomes versus waiting for the opposite third-contact signal.
parameter_rationale: Two entry presets fixed before inspecting results: a=wing3/deviation2%/zone0.5%/age50, b=wing5/deviation4%/zone1%/age100. Each is crossed with chart/1D/1W lines, bounce/breakout entries and five exit rules: opposite entry, opposite projected line contact, 3%, 5%, 8% price target. All 60 combinations are tested.
baseline: Same-stock 25% buy-and-hold and the identical third-touch entries with opposite-signal exits; all modes share candles and costs.
signal_rule: Entries use the third-touch-line protocol. Exit modes: opposite third-touch signal; first bar touching the opposite projected line ahead of entry; first bar whose high/low reaches 3%, 5% or 8% from next-open entry price. Exit is decided on the completed signal bar and filled at the next open; no intrabar order-fill ordering is assumed. Opposite entry may close/reverse earlier. Both long and short are tested.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Choose the exit mode with the highest median net return in the last full train calendar year (2025) across identical symbol/timeframe/entry-preset/source/style cells. Report paired improvement versus opposite-signal exit, the fraction of positive months, median max drawdown and 2026 seen-history result; if the winner does not improve the paired median or its 2026 median is negative, make no adoption recommendation. This is an exit-method study, not a full factorial search of every entry parameter.
limitations: User-drawn line is an example, not a fixed objective indicator
A confirmed pivot is visible only wing bars after its center
No actual third-contact profit is assumed from the screenshot
Corporate actions are not fully covered; research status only
The 1D/1W line is projected in completed higher-bar steps during 1H/4H sessions, not fitted to wall-clock time.
Only two preregistered entry presets are used for exit comparison; other entry-exit interactions remain untested.

research_provenance.note: Visual example only; no future line or trade outcome is used as data.

signal_semantics: Single-stock long/short order signal on closed bar; next-open execution. Pivot is usable only on confirmation bar, never at its plotted historical position.
availability_lag: Chart pivot: wing completed chart bars; daily/weekly pivot: wing completed higher bars plus next trading date after confirming higher candle. No current unfinished day/week is used.
